evidence_quotes.agenda: Never asked — call opens by confirming pre-filled web-inquiry details and moves straight into logistics with no concerns question.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A applied — no move-related concern was ever raised; the conversation stays on factual logistics (furniture, boxes, access) throughout discovery.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Self-prep tip landed ('the better you are at consolidating things into boxes... the less money you end up spending') and the estimate-variability framing landed, but no rate-commit line, no pay-less-if-faster line, and no 'does that feel fair' check.

top_strength: Thorough, well-organized differentiator delivery (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee) all landed clearly in one clean block, and he patiently untangled the customer's confusion about the weekday/weekend rate change.
coaching_note: The agenda question never got asked, so there was nothing to launch a two-layers-deep discovery from — opening with 'other than price, what are your biggest concerns' would surface something to work with before the pitch.
